text_block_list.text:
Out of breath,
Haru Urara returned. With a 
phenomenal run, she conquered the Arima 
Kinen!

Surrounded by an outpouring of 
congratulations from the shopping
district 
folks and countless rivals, Haru Urara 
savored the joy to the fullest.

And so, having run with all her heart 
across the dream stage,
Haru Urara's Arima 
Kinen came to an end.
